The increased weight given to Angular, without demonstrable project experience or demonstrable skills within the VR/AR context, suggests prestige bias – assigning more weight to the presence of a popular framework simply because it's listed in a widely used tech stack rather than its relevance to the role's technical requirements.  A fairer alternative would be to assess the candidate’s skill in JavaScript (specifically Angular) relative to the broader VR/AR stack and their demonstrated understanding of the core project requirements.
